content.text:
## Repository overview

```
Phy/
├── qb/                          # Active Physics question banks (45 folders)
├── dse/
│   ├── Year/{MC,LQ,Answer}/     # Raw past-paper PDFs
│   ├── Year2/{2012..2026,...}/  # Per-year full papers + marking schemes
│   ├── preprocessed/{MC,LQ}/    # Intermediate PNG extraction
│   ├── processed/
│   │   ├── MC/                  # qN.png, mc_questions.json, answer_keys.json
│   │   └── LQ/                  # qN.png, lq_questions.json, ocr_cache/
│   ├── scripts/                 # OCR, classify, PDF build pipelines
│   ├── topic/                   # 31 numbered syllabus-topic PDFs
│   └── DSE/by-topic/            # Sparse/partial mirror (mostly LQ copies)
├── notes/                       # **Main by-topic hub** (5 chapters × 34 subtopics)
│   ├── _notes-shared/preamble.tex
│   ├── _qb-assets/QB4xx/        # Extracted QB figures (p-01.png, …)
│   ├── {Chapter}/{Subtopic}/
│   │   ├── questions/           # DSE MC PNGs: {year}_q{n}.png
│   │   ├── lq/                  # DSE LQ PNGs
│   │   └── notes/               # .tex sources + compiled PDFs
│   ├── classification.json, summary.json
│   └── lq_classification.json, lq_summary.json
├── active-physics/              # Textbook PDFs (Book 2, 4, 5)
├── notes2/                      # Compiled Book 1–5 + all-in-one.pdf
├── success-key/                 # Checkpoint answer PDFs (em, wave, atomic-world)
├── .cursor/rules/               # Empty (no rules yet)
└── (no AGENTS.md, no SKILL.md)
```

**Path note:** Scripts in `dse/scripts/` write to `dse/by-topic/`, but that folder does not exist. The live output is at repo-root `notes/`. `NOTES_README.md` references `DSE/by-topic/` — treat `notes/` as the canonical by-topic location.

---

## 1. `qb/` — Active Physics question banks

**Organization:** One folder per bank, ~45 total.

| Prefix | Maps to |
|--------|---------|
| `QB_1xx` | Book 1 (Heat & Gases) |
| `QB_2xx` | Book 2 (Force & Motion) |
| `QB_3Axx` / `QB_3Bxx` | Book 3 (Wave Motion) |
| `QB_4xx` | Book 4 (Electricity & Magnetism) |
| `QB_5xx` | Book 5 (Radiation) |
| `QB_Exxx` | Extension/elective banks |

**Naming:** `{book}_ch{NN}_{TYPE}_e.{ext}`

- **TYPE:** `MC`, `LQ`, `RQ` (review), `SQ` (short)
- **Formats:** `.docx` (primary), `.pdf` (some exports)
- **Solutions:** Separate `*_answer.docx` / `*_answer.pdf` for MC (and some LQ)
- Some folders also have combined PDFs (`motion1.pdf`, `ch01.pdf`)

**Example (`QB_402`):** `4_ch02_MC_e.docx`, `4_ch02_MC_e_answer.pdf`, `4_ch02_LQ_e.docx`, etc.

---

## 2. `dse/processed` — Past-paper pipeline

**MC (`processed/MC/`):**
- Per-year PNGs: `processed/MC/{year}/q{n}.png` (2012–2026, plus `ppp`, `sapp`)
- `mc_questions.json` — OCR text, options, correct answer, %, chapter/subtopic classification
- `answer_keys.json` — keys from `Year/Answer/{year}ans.pdf`
- `ocr_cache/` — raw OCR per question

**LQ (`processed/LQ/`):**
- Same year/qN layout; `lq_questions.json` with OCR statements
- `ocr_cache/{year}/qN.txt`

**Raw sources:** `dse/Year/MC/`, `dse/Year/LQ/`, `dse/Year/Answer/`

**Classification scripts:**
- `classify_by_topic.py` → syncs `questions/`, auto-generates `notes/mc-bank.tex`
- `classify_lq_by_topic.py` → syncs `lq/`, generates `notes/lq-bank.tex`

---

## 3. `active-physics/` — Textbooks & checkpoints

- **Textbooks:** `Book 2.pdf`, `Book 4.pdf`, `Book 5.pdf` only (Books 1 & 3 in `notes2/`)
- **No separate checkpoint files** in-repo; checkpoints appear embedded in textbook PDFs
- **Checkpoint answers:** `success-key/` (`em-success-key.pdf`, `wave-success-key.pdf`, `atomic-world-success-key.pdf`)
- Teaching notes reference textbooks via header: `\fancyhead[R]{\small Book 4}`

---

## 4. `notes/` — Existing note patterns

**Taxonomy** (5 chapters, 34 subtopics — defined in `classify_by_topic.py`):
Heat and Gases · Force and Motion · Wave Motion · Electricity and Magnetism · Radiation

**Per subtopic layout:**
```
notes/{Chapter}/{Subtopic}/
  questions/     # DSE MC images (auto-synced)
  lq/            # DSE LQ images (curated)
  all.pdf        # chapter-level concat (optional)
  notes/
    {topic}.tex  # hand-written teaching notes (E&M only so far)
    mc-bank.tex  # AUTO-GENERATED — do not edit
    lq-bank.tex  # curated long-question bank
```

**Teaching notes exist for all 6 E&M subtopics** (`electrostatics.tex`, `circuits.tex`, `domestic.tex`, `magnetism.tex`, `induction.tex`, `ac_transformers.tex`). Other chapters have MC/LQ banks only.

**Conventions** (from `notes/_notes-shared/preamble.tex` + sample `circuits.tex`):

| Element | Macro / pattern |
|---------|-----------------|
| Build | LuaLaTeX (`% !TEX program = lualatex`) |
| Style ref | `notes2/all-in-one.pdf` — compact, bullets, tables, diagrams |
| Section IDs | Syllabus numbering: `4.1 Electrostatics`, `4.2 Electric circuits` |
| Key formulas | `\formulabox{...}` (yellow box) |
| Concept checks | `\conceptcheck{...}` (no printed answer) |
| Worked examples | `\example` / `\question` + `\sol[height]{solution}` |
| Past-paper MC | `\worked{year}{q}{key}{%}{../questions/YYYY_qN.png}{sol}` |
| QB text MC | `\qbtext{label}{stem}{key}{solution}` |
| Notes/remarks | `\note{...}`, `\remark{...}` |
| DSE practice | `\mcpractice`, `\lqpractice` in bank files |
| Diagrams | TikZ, circuitikz (European style) |

**Content style:** Clear prose, bullet lists, comparison tables, numbered examples with empty solution boxes for students (solutions kept in source only via `\sol`).

---

## 5. Skills / agent config

- **No** `AGENTS.md`, **no** `SKILL.md`, **no** `.cursor/skills/`
- `.cursor/rules/` exists but is **empty**
- Root PDFs `lasing-skills.pdf`, `siuma-skills.pdf` may be external skill references

---

## Recommended skill

**Name:** `hkdse-physics-notes`

**Suggested `SKILL.md` sections:**

1. **Purpose & triggers** — When to write/extend HKDSE Physics teaching notes
2. **Repository map** — `notes/`, `qb/`, `dse/processed/`, `active-physics/`, `success-key/`
3. **Syllabus taxonomy** — 5 chapters, 34 subtopics (from `classify_by_topic.py`)
4. **File layout per subtopic** — `notes/{chapter}/{subtopic}/notes/{topic}.tex`
5. **LaTeX toolchain** — LuaLaTeX, `\input{../../../_notes-shared/preamble.tex}`, `.latexmkrc`
6. **Macro reference** — `\formulabox`, `\conceptcheck`, `\example`/`\sol`, `\worked`, `\qbtext`, `\note`
7. **Style guide** — Match `all-in-one.pdf`; section numbering; Book N headers; diagram conventions
8. **Problem integration** — How to pull DSE MC (`questions/`, `mc_questions.json`) and QB problems (`qb/`, `_qb-assets/`)
9. **Pipeline commands** — `classify_by_topic.py`, `classify_lq_by_topic.py`, `ocr_mc_questions.py`, etc.
10. **Do-not-edit rules** — `mc-bank.tex` is auto-generated; never delete hand-written `.tex`
11. **Path caveat** — Scripts target `dse/by-topic/` but output lives in `notes/`; clarify or symlink before running
12. **Checkpoint alignment** — Map Active Physics Book chapters + `success-key/` answers to note sections
13. **Quality checklist** — TOC, concept checks per section, worked examples, past-paper `\worked` where relevant
